title: Saiyan through the Snake way!

prism_sessions.role: title, How to play, start, HUD

menus: STAMPED, AND POINTED AT THE DOOR
W / S TO MOVE · ENTER TO SELECT

declared_in_how_to_play: Flight: E to take off and land
In flight: W/S climb/dive, A/D steer
End of Snake Way: Space to jump to King Kai’s world
King Kai’s world: W/S walk, A/D turn, Space jump, E go home
Road home: already flying; Ki brings you down; Shift is twice the speed of the white aura
If you fall: land in Hell, run to the light; the ogre catches you if knocked down

mechanic_notes: No lives and no health bar; a 365-day calendar is the run budget.
Every stumble, fall, and minute of Kaio-ken spends days.
The route has a flight phase, King Kai’s world on foot, and a road-home flight phase.
Falling sends the runner to Hell; the ogre only gains when something knocks the runner down.
limitations: HUD values 35 and 0 have no visible label; they are likely speed/ki but are unconfirmed.
No window.__game state exposed; exact time/speed constants not extracted.
